# software id = <redacted-by-obi>

# model = CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS

/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=sfp-sfpplus11 ] name=sfp-sfpplus11-yellowwood
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=sfp-sfpplus12 ] name=sfp-sfpplus12-tamarack-gw
/interface wireguard add listen-port=51820 mtu=1420 name=wireguard1-users
/interface list add name=LAN
/interface list add name=WAN
/routing id add disabled=no id=172.18.73.1 name=id-1
/routing ospf instance add in-filter-chain=ospf-in-filter-chain name=ospf-instance-1 originate-default=if-installed out-filter-chain=ospf-out-filter-chain redistribute="" router-id=id-1
/routing ospf area add instance=ospf-instance-1 name=ospf-area-1
/routing table add comment="egress via Yellowwood" fib name=yellowwood
/snmp community set [ find default=yes ] name=<redacted-by-obi>
/system logging action set 3 remote=172.18.84.101
/ip neighbor discovery-settings set discover-interface-list=LAN
/interface list member add interface=sfp-sfpplus12-tamarack-gw list=LAN
/interface list member add interface=wireguard1-users list=LAN
/interface list member add interface=lo list=LAN
/interface list member add interface=sfp-sfpplus11-yellowwood list=WAN
/interface wireguard peers add allowed-address=172.18.169.101/32 comment=user-1 interface=wireguard1-users name=user-1 public-key=<redacted-by-obi>
/interface wireguard peers add allowed-address=172.18.169.102/32 comment="user-31" interface=wireguard1-users name="user-31" public-key=<redacted-by-obi>
/interface wireguard peers add allowed-address=172.18.169.103/32 comment="user-33" interface=wireguard1-users name="user-33" public-key=<redacted-by-obi>
/interface wireguard peers add allowed-address=172.18.169.104/32 comment=user-7 interface=wireguard1-users name=user-7 public-key=<redacted-by-obi>
/interface wireguard peers add allowed-address=172.18.169.105/32 comment=user-35 interface=wireguard1-users name=user-35 public-key=<redacted-by-obi>
/interface wireguard peers add allowed-address=172.18.169.106/32 comment=obi interface=wireguard1-users name=obi public-key=<redacted-by-obi>
/ip address add address=169.254.13.11/31 comment=peer-tamarack-gw interface=sfp-sfpplus12-tamarack-gw network=169.254.13.10
/ip address add address=172.18.73.1/24 interface=lo network=172.18.73.0
/ip address add address=172.18.169.1/24 interface=wireguard1-users network=172.18.169.0
/ip cloud set ddns-enabled=yes update-time=no
/ip dhcp-client add default-route-distance=100 default-route-tables=main,yellowwood interface=sfp-sfpplus11-yellowwood use-peer-dns=no use-peer-ntp=no
/ip dns set allow-remote-requests=yes servers=172.18.81.101,172.18.84.101
/ip firewall filter add action=fasttrack-connection chain=forward comment=fasttrack connection-state=established,related
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=forward comment="accept established,related,untracked" connection-state=established,related,untracked
/ip firewall filter add action=drop chain=forward comment="drop invalid" connection-state=invalid
/ip firewall filter add action=drop chain=forward comment="drop all from WAN not DSTNATed" connection-nat-state=!dstnat in-interface-list=WAN
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="accept established,related,untracked" connection-state=established,related,untracked
/ip firewall filter add action=drop chain=input comment="drop invalid" connection-state=invalid
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="accept ICMP" protocol=icmp
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="accept wireguard" dst-port=51820 in-interface-list=WAN protocol=udp
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=input comment="accept d3.example.net" src-address=198.18.9.177
/ip firewall filter add action=drop chain=input comment="drop all not coming from LAN" in-interface-list=!LAN
/ip firewall mangle add action=mark-routing chain=output comment="pin MikroTik Cloud to Yellowwood" dst-port=15252 new-routing-mark=yellowwood passthrough=no protocol=udp
/ip firewall nat add action=masquerade chain=srcnat in-interface-list=LAN out-interface=sfp-sfpplus11-yellowwood
/ip service set ftp disabled=yes
/ip service set telnet disabled=yes
/routing filter rule add chain=ospf-in-filter-chain rule="if (dst in 169.254.0.0/16) { set comment \"ospf-in rejected\"; reject }"
/routing filter rule add chain=ospf-in-filter-chain rule="set pref-src 172.18.73.1"
/routing filter rule add chain=ospf-in-filter-chain rule=accept
/routing filter rule add chain=ospf-out-filter-chain rule="if (dst==0.0.0.0/0 && protocol dhcp) { set ospf-ext-type type2; accept }"
/routing filter rule add chain=ospf-out-filter-chain disabled=yes rule="if (dst==0.0.0.0/0 && protocol ospf) { reject }"
/routing ospf interface-template add area=ospf-area-1 interfaces=lo passive
/routing ospf interface-template add area=ospf-area-1 interfaces=sfp-sfpplus12-tamarack-gw type=ptp
/routing ospf interface-template add area=ospf-area-1 interfaces=wireguard1-users passive
/snmp set enabled=yes
/system clock set time-zone-name=America/New_York
/system identity set name=tamarack-gw-yellowwood
/system logging set 0 topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=remote topics=info
/system logging add action=remote topics=warning
/system logging add action=remote topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system ntp server set enabled=yes use-local-clock=yes
/system ntp client servers add address=0.us.pool.ntp.org
/system ntp client servers add address=1.us.pool.ntp.org
/system ntp client servers add address=2.us.pool.ntp.org
/system ntp client servers add address=3.us.pool.ntp.org
/system ntp client servers add address=172.18.84.1
/system ntp client servers add address=172.18.89.1
/system package update set channel=long-term
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/tool graphing interface add interface=sfp-sfpplus11-yellowwood
/tool graphing interface add interface=wireguard1-users
/tool graphing resource add
/tool netwatch add comment=tamarack-gw-yellowwood-google host=192.0.2.8 name=tamarack-gw-yellowwood-google type=simple
/tool netwatch add comment=tamarack-gw-yellowwood-cloudflare host=198.51.100.1 name=tamarack-gw-yellowwood-cloudflare type=simple
/tool netwatch add comment=tamarack-gw-yellowwood-tamarack host=169.254.13.10 name=tamarack-gw-yellowwood-tamarack type=simple
